claims.claim: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced a two-month extension of the U.S.-China trade truce until January.
claims.episode_span: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced that Washington and Beijing have agreed to keep existing tariff and export arrangements in place for another two months.
claims.source_title: US and China agree to extend trade truce until January: Bessent
claims.supporting_quote: The U.S. and China have agreed to extend a fragile trade truce by two months until January, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Wednesday.

claims.claim: Nepal’s government is seeking roughly $5 billion for flood recovery after recent damage.
claims.episode_span: Nepal’s government is trying to raise roughly $5 billion after recent floods caused widespread damage.
claims.source_title: Nepal struggles to raise $5bn for flood recovery as global aid retreats
claims.supporting_quote: Nepal struggles to raise $5bn for flood recovery as global aid retreats
